query:
SELECT COALESCE(album, '(unknown)') AS "name!: String",
                COUNT(*) AS "count!: i64",
                COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) AS "total_size!: i64",
                COALESCE(SUM(duration), 0) AS "total_duration!: i64"
                FROM tracks WHERE library_id = ? GROUP BY album ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1
